commands.name: setup
commands.description: Interactively add and authenticate a new provider.

options.name: --target
options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Pre-select the provider to configure (github-copilot | openai | anthropic). Skips the interactive provider-selection prompt and runs the rest of the setup flow (API-key prompt or OAuth device-code flow). Useful for scripting and integration tests.

options.name: --target
options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add or update a provider non-interactively. Useful for scripts and CI.

options.name: --name
options.description: Provider name (e.g. 'openai', 'integration-mock').

options.name: --api
options.description: API contract handled by this provider (e.g. 'openai-completions', 'openai-responses', 'anthropic-messages', 'integration-mock'). Defaults to 'openai-completions'.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key value, or 'auth:<name>' to reference an auth.json OAuth entry.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, or catalog path for 'integration-mock'.

options.name: --default-model
options.description: Default model id for this provider.

options.name: --model
options.description: Allowed model id (repeatable). Omit to allow all models registered for this provider.

options.name: --disabled
options.description: Mark the provider as disabled. Disabled providers are hidden from the API.

options.description: BotNexus home directory (config, workspace, extensions). Defaults to ~/.botnexus.
